subject.title: Expose maxMissedJobsPerRestart and missedJobStaggerMs in cron config

question: Should OpenClaw expose public cron restart catch-up controls, and should the supported API be the existing global max/stagger knobs, a skip/freshness policy, or no new public config?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but adding openclaw.json keys changes a public config contract and the semantics of scheduled messages after restart, so automation should not choose the permanent API shape.

options.title: Expose Narrow Global Controls
options.body: Approve documented global cron restart catch-up controls using the existing max/stagger behavior, including explicit zero-limit semantics to disable immediate catch-up.

options.title: Design Skip Or Freshness Policy
options.body: Define a global or per-job skip/freshness policy instead of exposing raw internal knobs, while preserving current catch-up defaults for existing users.

options.title: Keep Controls Internal
options.body: Decline new public config and document the current restart catch-up behavior plus safer cron authoring patterns.

recommendation.title: Expose Narrow Global Controls
recommendation.body: Approve documented global cron restart catch-up controls using the existing max/stagger behavior, including explicit zero-limit semantics to disable immediate catch-up.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the original internal restart-staggering behavior and is the strongest routed owner for turning it into a public config policy.
